7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Lucita and I had just concluded our preparatory visit to Terador Air Force Base.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: The city sustained heavy damage when Rizia reconquered it in the 1920s. Attempts had been made to revitalize it, but several bombed-out, derelict buildings still stood in its center.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: She ordered our driver to stop in front of the tallest one. It was completely boarded up, and the remains of a fire escape dangled precariously from the fifth story.

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "This is what you wanted me to see, isn't it? We took back this city, and we will take back the rest."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Pretty. But I'm not in the mood for art."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "Titus, can you go in and secure the area?"

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: She gave me a scornful look.

14.speaker: Lucita Azaro
14.text: "You don't need Titus. You're with me."

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: In the dimming light of the setting sun, I could just make out an old mural painted on its side -- an angular, 1920s-style depiction of a paleacci, defaced almost beyond recognition.

19.speaker: Lucita Azaro
19.text: "The mural's not important. Let's go in."

20.speaker: Lucita Azaro
20.text: "We won't be long. Come with me."

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "Where are you taking me, Duchess Azaro?"

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: She instructed my bodyguard to wait in the car and led me up to the entrance. Drawing a key from her pocket, she unlocked the door.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: Flickering lights illuminated the building's decrepit interior. We walked across the uneven concrete floor, stepping around shards of glass, until we came to an elevator shaft guarded by a man in a crisp blue jacket.

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: I noticed a brooch on his lapel shaped like a pair of swords. He and Lucita exchanged nods as he let us into the elevator.

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: We ascended to what must have been the very top floor. The elevator door opened, and we stepped out.

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: Immediately, the atmosphere transformed. We were in a chic-looking lounge, its furnishings sleek and understated. The soft strains of jazz filled the air.

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: A handful of patrons were sitting around sipping cocktails. They paid us no mind as we crossed the room to a cozy private booth by the window.

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "What a brilliant idea. I'd love a drink."

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "The guard here was wearing an Azaro sigil..."

37.speaker: Lucita Azaro
37.text: "Of course he was. My family has used this place as a member's club since Rizia took back the Pales Administrative District."

38.speaker: Lucita Azaro
38.text: "My family bought this building when Rizia took back the Pales Administrative District. We've been using it as a member's club of sorts."

42.speaker: Lucita Azaro
42.text: "It was about time we went on that date. And if we can't step out in public, we might as well come here."

47.speaker: Lucita Azaro
47.text: "Until we're ready to go public, this is the closest we can get to a proper date."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "I still find this ridiculous. I should be able to date my councilors if I want to."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "Isn't this public? What if someone talks?"

52.speaker: Lucita Azaro
52.text: "You looked like you could use a break from Ironjaw down there."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "You've got that right. Titus has barely let me out of his sights since Zille."

55.speaker: Lucita Azaro
55.text: "His old boxing nickname. Didn't you follow his career before he joined the Golden Guard?"

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "For your information, I like the man. He's far more trustworthy than... some people I know."

60.speaker: Lucita Azaro
60.text: "You know my feelings about him. He's up to something."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "You are wasting the King's time, Duchess. But since I'm here... one drink."

65.speaker: Lucita Azaro
65.text: "I don't know how you deal with it. My own guards are paid very handsomely to leave me alone."

66.speaker: Lucita Azaro
66.text: "There's something about him that doesn't sit right with me. But I trust him if you do."

67.speaker: Lucita Azaro
67.text: "I don't want to live life stewing over the opportunities I missed."

68.speaker: Lucita Azaro
68.text: "This club takes its discretion policy seriously, Your Majesty. Many of its guests would be in prison if it didn't."

69.speaker: Lucita Azaro
69.text: "Now that you mention it, I have good news."

73.speaker: Lucita Azaro
73.text: "We had this conversation, Your Majesty. It's even more important not to publicize our personal relationship now that we're at war."

75.speaker: Narrator
75.text: A bow-tied server approached our booth to take our orders. I took a look at the cocktail menu.

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "Not many women would be so bold. I love that about you."

84.speaker: Lucita Azaro
84.text: "A beer for me, then. Whatever's on tap."

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: The server bowed and left to fetch our drinks.

86.speaker: Narrator
86.text: While we were waiting, Lucita gestured out the window. Beyond the twinkling lights of downtown Terador, a line of steadily flashing beacons marked the border wall between Rizia and Pales.

87.speaker: Lucita Azaro
87.text: "You're talking to Reinhart soon, aren't you? There's no going back from that."

94.speaker: Lucita Azaro
94.text: "There it is. The country that gave us so much grief."
94.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == false)

95.speaker: Lucita Azaro
95.text: "There it is. Our new business partner."
95.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == false) == false)

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "I can't believe our fathers wanted us to invade. Our current arrangement makes so much more sense."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "Maybe it won't take a war for Pales to reunite with Rizia. We can find an economic solution."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "I have a bad feeling about it."

102.speaker: Lucita Azaro
102.text: "The news of our impending war seemed to drastically speed up his recovery. I wouldn't be surprised if he's back on his feet by the time the war begins."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "I just hope we can get Vina back before it all goes to hell."

108.speaker: Lucita Azaro
108.text: "No matter what, I'll see to her safe return. My father will, too."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "The Lord has seen fit to send us to war. He will oversee our swift victory."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "My father is finally getting his wish."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "I can't believe we came so close to war. It would've been a terrible mistake."

121.speaker: Lucita Azaro
121.text: "For what it's worth, I do think we would have won. Our military's the strongest it's been in decades."

122.speaker: Lucita Azaro
122.text: "Given our lack of investment in the military, our showing would've been quite poor. Better to play it safe than risk losing even more of the country."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "I wish I'd had the nerve to order an invasion. All that hassle and we didn't even get a share of the gas field."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "I hope the gas from Aureus is worth everything we went through."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "Are you disappointed we didn't start a war?"

131.speaker: Lucita Azaro
131.text: "As long as Pales holds up its end of the bargain."

132.speaker: Lucita Azaro
132.text: "I just hope Reinhart holds up his end of the bargain."

136.speaker: Lucita Azaro
136.text: "As long as Lespia is in the picture, it won't be easy."

140.speaker: Lucita Azaro
140.text: "And even if the Palesians can be trusted, can Lespia?"

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "Not by choice. But it was either this, or start a war."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "That's amazing news. I'm looking forward to working with the General again."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "That old dinosaur will be more of a hindrance than a help."

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "What a shame. I was looking forward to watching you order our troops around."

154.speaker: Lucita Azaro
154.text: "You'll still get plenty of that. But he'll be invaluable for behind-the-scenes strategizing."

155.speaker: Lucita Azaro
155.text: "I never wanted to end up in another war with Pales. But if we must fight, then I'm glad to have him with us."

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: She gave me an offended look.

157.speaker: Lucita Azaro
157.text: "Without him, we'd be sitting in Palesian territory right now."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "Bullshit, Lucita. I know you were behind the Pales border attack."

162.speaker: Narrator
162.text: Shock and rage exploded on her face.

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: Just then, the server returned with our drinks.

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: He carefully placed our Palesian Sunsets on the table. They were garnished with tiny umbrellas.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: He carefully placed our Siegebreaker Slings on the table. They were garnished with maraschino cherries.

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: He carefully placed our Terador Teas on the table. They were served in gold-plated mugs.
178.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_LucitaMeeting_Drink_PalesianSunset"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_LucitaMeeting_Drink_SiegebreakerSling"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_LucitaMeeting_Drink_TeradorTea"] == true)

179.speaker: Narrator
179.text: He carefully placed my water and Lucita's beer on the table.
179.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_LucitaMeeting_Drink_PalesianSunset"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_LucitaMeeting_Drink_SiegebreakerSling"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_LucitaMeeting_Drink_TeradorTea"] == true) == false)

180.speaker: Narrator
180.text: Lucita waited until he was gone to speak.

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "You're too beautiful to rot in prison."
184.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_PromisedDate"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "I want to go to war with you by my side."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "Because now I have you and your family completely at my mercy. If I want something from you, you're going to give it to me."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "War with Pales was always going to be inevitable. If you didn't start something, I would have."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "I'm still unsure whether you planned the attack. I wanted to see how you'd react when I accused you."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "I trust our troops will obey him this time around."

191.speaker: Lucita Azaro
191.text: "This will be nothing like the last war, Your Majesty."

195.speaker: Player_Romus
195.text: "All the help in the world won't matter with a subpar military."
195.conditionsRaw:
((Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or 
Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

196.speaker: Lucita Azaro
196.text: "We could be more prepared, it's true. But if we get creative, we can still win this."

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "We don't need his help. Look at how strong our military is now."
197.conditionsRaw:
((Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or 
Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

198.speaker: Lucita Azaro
198.text: "As long as Lespian interference is a possibility, we need all the help we can get."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "Come on. There must be some part of you that's excited by the idea of crushing the Palesians to a pulp."

203.speaker: Lucita Azaro
203.text: "Close friends of House Azaro. We've been using this building as member's club since Rizia took back the Pales Administrative District."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "Will he be fit enough to resume his old position?"

206.speaker: Lucita Azaro
206.text: "Time will tell. At the very least, he'll be able to help with behind-the-scenes strategizing."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "Are you sure about that? Because the border investigation results seemed to imply otherwise."

212.speaker: Narrator
212.text: We took our beverages and raised them.

224.speaker: Narrator
224.text: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

226.speaker: Narrator
226.text: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

228.speaker: Narrator
228.text: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

230.speaker: Narrator
230.text: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

232.speaker: Narrator
232.text: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

240.speaker: Narrator
240.text: She looked at me as if I'd grown a second head.

241.speaker: Lucita Azaro
241.text: "He's been out of commission for too long."

245.speaker: Lucita Azaro
245.text: "I wanted to tell you something while we were here."

246.speaker: Lucita Azaro
246.text: "My house has begun to complain to me about the way you've been running the country."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "Everyone's a critic. Why should I care?"

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "Tell them to take it up with my complaint department. It's in the Citadel prison."

252.speaker: Player_Romus
252.text: "I have three royal houses to cater to, on top of the Rizian public. It can't be all Azaros, all the time."

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "The Azaros are turning against me? That's not good."

257.speaker: Lucita Azaro
257.text: "We'll have a hell of a hard time winning the war if we can't marshall support from my family."

260.speaker: Narrator
260.text: She had a skeptical look in her eyes.

264.speaker: Lucita Azaro
264.text: "We could've taken the whole field if we wanted. Our military's the strongest it's been in years."

265.speaker: Lucita Azaro
265.text: "We could've taken the whole field without a struggle. If we'd invested more in the military, I mean."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "A strong military is like a theater costume. You want to have it for the show, but it's ridiculous to use it in real life."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "As long as Lespia's lurking about, we would have lost again."

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "I took the throne with the aim of avoiding conflict. I am proud to have stayed the course."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "I love a good battle as much as the next chap. But I didn't want to risk further jeopardizing the return of Zille."

278.speaker: Narrator
278.text: She gave my a sly smile.

280.speaker: Lucita Azaro
280.text: "Defeating Pales would've sent Smolak a strong message about how Rizia deals with misbehaving neighbors."

281.speaker: Lucita Azaro
281.text: "Courses change. You couldn't have known what Pales was about to do."

284.speaker: Lucita Azaro
284.text: "But you're right. My family may have wanted another war with the Grand Duchy, but not me."

288.speaker: Player_Romus
288.text: "Admit it. Some part of you was excited by the idea of crushing Pales to a pulp."

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "And how is House Azaro feeling about the fact that we aren't at war right now?"

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "Thank God I have such a sensible war councilor."

293.speaker: Lucita Azaro
293.text: "I still think avoiding conflict with Pales was the correct strategy. Of course, not everyone in Rizia feels the same way."

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: "You're my war councilor. And you truly didn't want us to go to war?"

295.speaker: Player_Romus
295.text: "Who dares disagree with my diplomatic strategy? Tell me, and I'll have their heads."

300.speaker: Player_Romus
300.text: "Making unpopular decisions is part and parcel of being king. I've learned not to let it affect me."

301.speaker: Lucita Azaro
301.text: "It's a lot of heads, Your Majesty."

305.speaker: Lucita Azaro
305.text: "I do appreciate the investments you've made in our military. But it made no sense to waste them on this."

306.speaker: Lucita Azaro
306.text: "Given our lack of investment in the military, our showing would've been quite poor. Better to play it safe than risk losing even more of the country."

308.speaker: Lucita Azaro
308.text: "I hate to say it, but too many unpopular decisions *will* affect you."

309.speaker: Lucita Azaro
309.text: "They are not asking for special privileges. Only for acknowledgement."

311.speaker: Lucita Azaro
311.text: "I've heard rumors of your plans to change the Rizian government. They won't make it off the ground without my family's support."

315.speaker: Lucita Azaro
315.text: "House Azaro controls the military as well as much of Rizia's industrial production. You don't want Cardesse-Montaklar on your bad side."

316.speaker: Narrator
316.text: She looked me in the eye.

317.speaker: Lucita Azaro
317.text: "I am innocent, Your Majesty. But I recognize that turning me in would have been the easiest thing to do."

321.speaker: Narrator
321.text: A look of confusion spread across her face.

322.speaker: Lucita Azaro
322.text: "I hope you're satisfied with my reaction."

324.speaker: Lucita Azaro
324.text: "I have tried to justify your actions to the others. But there's only so much I can explain away."

329.speaker: Lucita Azaro
329.text: "I shouldn't be blathering on like this on the eve of a war."

330.speaker: Lucita Azaro
330.text: "Simply put, Your Majesty, my family likes order."

340.speaker: Lucita Azaro
340.text: "While we're here, I wanted to thank you for everything you've done for House Azaro over the past years."

341.speaker: Player_Romus
341.text: "I've been following my own instincts. If those happen to align with House Azaro's interests, so much the better."

345.speaker: Player_Romus
345.text: "Well, thanks to House Azaro for not usurping me."

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "I need your family's support. Especially with war in the cards."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "No need to thank me. Your house and mine share a special bond."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "Pleasing your family isn't as important to me as pleasing you."

358.speaker: Lucita Azaro
358.text: "That's very sweet. I congratulate you on managing both."

359.speaker: Lucita Azaro
359.text: "You've managed one of those. The second will surely follow."

361.speaker: Lucita Azaro
361.text: "Not every king would see the wisdom in honoring it."

362.speaker: Lucita Azaro
362.text: "Ha. You don't need to worry about that."

363.speaker: Lucita Azaro
363.text: "War is a terrible thing. It's not a decision to be made lightly."

364.speaker: Narrator
364.text: I felt her foot brush against mine under the table.

369.speaker: Lucita Azaro
369.text: "I confess there are a few holdouts who wish the Pales gas dispute had ended with an annexation."

374.speaker: Lucita Azaro
374.text: "But your commitment to our kingdom's national defense has reassured them that Rizia will be ready for the next war, if and when it ever comes."

375.speaker: Lucita Azaro
375.text: "I personally wish you had made a larger commitment to Rizia's national defense than your predecessor. But there's still time."

376.speaker: Lucita Azaro
376.text: "Your readiness to defend Rizia against Palesian aggression won you many admirers in Cardesse-Montaklar."

377.speaker: Lucita Azaro
377.text: "Yes, there are those of us who wish you had done more to prepare our kingdom for the war we now find ourselves facing."

381.speaker: Lucita Azaro
381.text: "As did the steps you took to prepare our kingdom for the war we now find ourselves facing."

616.text: "Strong bonds between the Crown and the military have always served this country well."

617.speaker: Narrator
617.text: She took a sip of her drink and lightly touched my shoulder.

618.speaker: Player_Romus
618.text: "I can, and it chills me to the bone."

623.speaker: Player_Romus
623.text: "There's only one way a regime like that can end. With the king's beheading."

624.speaker: Player_Romus
624.text: "It's better than a king with absolute power."

626.speaker: Lucita Azaro
626.text: "She never got the chance to go into detail. But it wouldn't be impossible today."

627.speaker: Lucita Azaro
627.text: "The monarch gets to make the popular decisions while the military does the dirty work. Not a bad balance."

628.speaker: Lucita Azaro
628.text: "Military officers are willing to die for their country. Why shouldn't they get a chance to rule it?"

629.speaker: Lucita Azaro
629.text: "Not if he and the military work together. As a single, well-oiled machine."

630.speaker: Lucita Azaro
630.text: "We'll never know whether it would have worked. But I do see potential in the idea."

631.speaker: Lucita Azaro
631.text: "But I'm getting ahead of myself. Our main focus should be on winning the war. We can revisit this idea later, once my father's well enough to discuss it."

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "I'm relieved his recovery is proceeding on course. It'll be a pleasure to work with him again."

637.speaker: Player_Romus
637.text: "I'm relieved his recovery is proceeding on course. It'll be a pleasure to work with him."

638.speaker: Player_Romus
638.text: "That old dinosaur will be more of a hindrance than a help."

639.speaker: Lucita Azaro
639.text: "Even incapacitated, he's one of the sharpest minds in the country."

640.speaker: Player_Romus
640.text: "I'm looking forward to finally speaking with the General again."

641.speaker: Player_Romus
641.text: "I've heard enough, thanks. Our military is powerful enough as it is."

642.speaker: Player_Romus
642.text: "The Pales campaign will be the ultimate test of the military's mettle. If our generals succeed, they'll have earned the right to rule by my side."

643.speaker: Player_Romus
643.text: "Confidentially, I feel the same way about the House of Delegates. They're a waste of money and a blight on my authority as King."

645.speaker: Lucita Azaro
645.text: "As you wish. I won't bring it up again."

646.speaker: Lucita Azaro
646.text: "He's looking forward to speaking with you as well. About a great many things."

648.speaker: Lucita Azaro
648.text: "What am I even doing, bringing all this up? We're here to relax."

651.speaker: Lucita Azaro
651.text: "Don't worry about the drinks, by the way. They're on the house."

654.speaker: Lucita Azaro
654.text: "Everything a king and his trusted councilor would need for a deep, stimulating strategizing session."

656.speaker: Narrator
656.text: She winked at me and slipped out of the booth.

659.speaker: Player_Romus
659.text: "You thought ahead. How suite of you."

660.speaker: Lucita Azaro
660.text: "Our troops will be with you every step of the way. And so will I."

661.speaker: Lucita Azaro
661.text: "I didn't know you were on it, Your Majesty."

662.speaker: Lucita Azaro
662.text: "I suppose that's sensible. We wouldn't want to get drunk on the eve of declaring war."

674.speaker: Lucita Azaro
674.text: "Peace between Rizia and Pales, and not a single drop of blood shed. Who would have thought."

675.speaker: Lucita Azaro
675.text: "You'll have my help with that. No alcohol necessary."

676.speaker: Lucita Azaro
676.text: "Courage alone is useless without planning and strength behind it."

677.speaker: Lucita Azaro
677.text: "You don't need alcohol for that. Remember, Your Majesty, you're not alone."

678.speaker: Lucita Azaro
678.text: "I hope you don't feel pressure to drink with me."

679.speaker: Player_Romus
679.text: "I might as well. Tonight could be our last night together."

681.speaker: Player_Romus
681.text: "You know... tonight could be our last night together."

682.speaker: Player_Romus
682.text: "I hope you know that buying me a drink doesn't entitle you or any other Azaro to special favors from me."

683.speaker: Player_Romus
683.text: "Thank you for bringing me here. I didn't know how much I needed a moment of respite."

684.speaker: Player_Romus
684.text: "The next time we come here, that border over there won't exist."

685.speaker: Player_Romus
685.text: "I might as well. Who knows what will happen tomorrow?"

686.speaker: Player_Romus
686.text: "Thank you for bringing me here. Dare I say my spirits have been lifted?"

702.speaker: Player_Romus
702.text: "For the pleasure of your company, Duchess, I would fall off a thousand wagons."

713.speaker: Player_Romus
713.text: "Once a party prince, always a party prince. No use in denying it."

717.speaker: Narrator
717.text: She laughed, then quickly assumed a more solemn expression.

718.speaker: Lucita Azaro
718.text: "I'm grateful for the audience with you, Your Majesty. You aren't obligated to act on anything I said."

719.speaker: Player_Romus
719.text: "You, pressuring me? The very idea is ludicrous."

720.speaker: Player_Romus
720.text: "I love that I can speak with you so openly. I'd love it even more if we found a more intimate venue to continue this conversation."

721.speaker: Narrator
721.text: She flashed me a knowing smile.

722.speaker: Lucita Azaro
722.text: "We'll replace it with a monument. To the lives we had to take to defend our sovereignty."

724.speaker: Lucita Azaro
724.text: "Sometimes a bird's-eye perspective is all it takes to achieve clarity."

725.speaker: Narrator
725.text: We finished our drinks as the city lights twinkled below us.

726.speaker: Narrator
726.text: All too soon, it was time to rejoin Titus and begin the trip back to the air force base.

727.speaker: Narrator
727.text: We finished our drinks as the city lights twinkled below us.

728.speaker: Narrator
728.text: Once we were done, we rejoined Titus to begin the trip back to the air force base.

729.speaker: Narrator
729.text: She blushed and lowered her eyes.

730.speaker: Lucita Azaro
730.text: "We should get back to the base. We wouldn't want to keep Titus waiting."

731.speaker: Narrator
731.text: Leaving my unfinished drink on the table, I followed her to the elevator.

732.speaker: Lucita Azaro
732.text: "The drinks are on you tonight, Your Majesty."

733.speaker: Lucita Azaro
733.text: "I truly apologize if I gave you that impression."

734.speaker: Lucita Azaro
734.text: "But I understand how committed you are to keeping the Toras crown. Much like your father before you."

735.speaker: Narrator
735.text: She slipped out of the booth.

738.speaker: Narrator
738.text: She downed the rest of her beverage in one go and hurriedly made her way to the elevator.

742.speaker: Narrator
742.text: She groaned and swatted my arm.

743.speaker: Lucita Azaro
743.text: "Is it too late to rescind my invitation?"

747.speaker: Player_Romus
747.text: "Fornication before marriage is a sin in the eyes of St. Wruhec."

748.speaker: Narrator
748.text: Her eyes widened. She cautiously laughed.

749.speaker: Lucita Azaro
749.text: "I'm sorry if you got the wrong idea, Your Majesty. I want to keep talking with you. That's all."

750.speaker: Player_Romus
750.text: "No... not tonight. We have all the time in the world."

752.speaker: Narrator
752.text: She slipped out of the booth.

753.speaker: Lucita Azaro
753.text: "Don't worry about paying for the drinks. They're on the house."

754.speaker: Narrator
754.text: With a wink, she headed past the bar down a darkened corridor. Leaving my unfinished drink on the table, I followed close behind.

756.speaker: Lucita Azaro
756.text: "Then we had better get a move on."

757.speaker: Narrator
757.text: Lucita and I had just concluded our visit to Terador Air Force Base.

761.speaker: Narrator
761.text: The base's new expansion was truly impressive.

765.speaker: Narrator
765.text: Construction on the expansion I'd ordered was still in progress. I knew that once it was complete, it would be truly impressive.

766.speaker: Narrator
766.text: The focus I'd devoted to the Rizian air force early in my reign was paying off. There were more officers and airplanes here than I'd ever seen before.
766.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Airforce"] == true)

773.speaker: Narrator
773.text: The top cadet gave us a demonstration of one of the new planes from Morella. Its speed and maneuverability put Rizian aircraft to shame.
773.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Airforce"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_MorellanAirPlanes"] == true)

777.speaker: Narrator
777.text: Amid the whirlwind of activity, we barely got a chance to speak to each other, let alone discuss the fallout of the border investigation.
777.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Airforce"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_MorellanAirPlanes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == true)

778.speaker: Narrator
778.text: On the way back to the motorcade, she asked me to accompany her downtown.

779.speaker: Narrator
779.text: Amid the whirlwind of activity, we barely got a chance to speak to each other.
779.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TeradorAirforceBaseExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Airforce"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_MorellanAirPlanes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == true) == false)

783.speaker: Lucita Azaro
783.text: "We're making our official declaration soon, aren't we? No going back from that."

784.speaker: Player_Romus
784.text: "I know you never wanted war. That's why I defended you against the investigation committee's accusations."

785.speaker: Narrator
785.text: A smile of gratitude blossomed on her face.

789.speaker: Lucita Azaro
789.text: "I didn't plan the border attack, Your Majesty."

790.speaker: Lucita Azaro
790.text: "But if you think I did, why didn't you arrest me?"

791.speaker: Lucita Azaro
791.text: "Your Majesty, I haven't had the chance to thank you for not giving in to Duke Reinhart's demands for my arrest."

792.speaker: Lucita Azaro
792.text: "Needless to say, the idea that I would have planned such a sloppy false flag operation is preposterous."

793.speaker: Player_Romus
793.text: "Unless... you were deliberately being sloppy so that when the investigation revealed it was you, I wouldn't believe it."

794.speaker: Player_Romus
794.text: "Alvarez must have really gone back to the bottle if he thought that'd work on me."

797.speaker: Player_Romus
797.text: "I can't believe Duke Reinhart thought I would turn you in and go back to our gas deal as if nothing had happened."

798.speaker: Lucita Azaro
798.text: "I wonder if he would do the same were it one of his councilors under investigation."

799.speaker: Lucita Azaro
799.text: "But I recognize that turning me in would have been the easiest thing to do."

800.speaker: Lucita Azaro
800.text: "I do recognize that turning me in would have been the easiest thing to do."

801.speaker: Player_Romus
801.text: "I never thought you were guilty. Mr. Esquibel had his suspicions."

803.speaker: Lucita Azaro
803.text: "It's the Duchess of Montaklar's word against some anonymous commanding officer's, and I'm the one they blame? Unbelievable."

805.speaker: Lucita Azaro
805.text: "I'm glad there's one man who saw through it all."

806.speaker: Lucita Azaro
806.text: "You have my gratitude. And that of my family."

809.speaker: Narrator
809.text: She raised her glass. I did the same.

811.speaker: Lucita Azaro
811.text: "So you have my gratitude. And that of my family."

815.speaker: Narrator
815.text: Still holding my gaze, she took a slow, reflective sip.

819.speaker: Lucita Azaro
819.text: "I will confess one thing to you, Your Majesty."

820.speaker: Lucita Azaro
820.text: "Before this investigation business, my house was complaining to me about the way you've been running the country."

821.speaker: Lucita Azaro
821.text: "And I'm still not sure that your exoneration of me has completely satisfied them."

822.speaker: Lucita Azaro
822.text: "My exoneration aside, I hope you know how much House Azaro appreciates everything you've done for them."

826.speaker: Lucita Azaro
826.text: "You're right. We'd have to be idiots to keep seeing each other after this, even in private."

828.speaker: Lucita Azaro
828.text: "Don't worry about the drinks tonight, Your Majesty. They're on the house."

839.speaker: Lucita Azaro
839.text: "His Majesty Valero told me he trusted General Taddeus with his life. Treat our house well, and he will be your fiercest protector."

843.speaker: Player_Romus
843.text: "Remind me. When did you last speak to King Valero?"

844.speaker: Lucita Azaro
844.text: "Tragically enough, on the day he died."

849.speaker: Player_Romus
849.text: "And if I *don't* treat your house well?"

851.speaker: Player_Romus
851.text: "My problems are too complex for a swordsman to solve."

852.speaker: Lucita Azaro
852.text: "He shoots guns, too. Don't forget about that."

853.speaker: Lucita Azaro
853.text: "I was at the Palace for an interview with Hugo. Your father signed the order for me to become interim war councilor."

854.speaker: Lucita Azaro
854.text: "Truth be told, we barely conversed. He was clearly preoccupied with other matters."

855.speaker: Player_Romus
855.text: "Should he rejoin the council, I will welcome him back with open arms."

857.speaker: Lucita Azaro
857.text: "Representation is important. But with the heads of our provincial armies on hand to advise you, the Delegates will be irrelevant."

863.speaker: Lucita Azaro
863.text: "We Azaros put a lot of work into training our provincial forces. You can imagine the uproar when they were placed under Crown control."
863.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialPolice"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_BorderSecurity_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DrugTrade_Persisting"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Revolutionaries_NonThreat"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialLevies"] == true)

867.speaker: Lucita Azaro
867.text: "Camp Domus drills loyalty to the Crown into its soldiers from day one of basic training. Your 'pledge of allegiance' decree struck the commanders there as a sign you don't trust them."
867.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialPolice"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_BorderSecurity_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DrugTrade_Persisting"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Revolutionaries_NonThreat"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_RemoveProvincialLevies"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_PledgeOfAllegiance"] == true)

870.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
870.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_PromisedDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == false) == false

871.speaker: Lucita Azaro
871.text: "Since it's just the two of us here, let me tell you something."

872.speaker: Lucita Azaro
872.text: "During the War of Rizian Succession, my ancestor Ana drew up plans for a monarcho-military system of government. Rizia, ruled by both a king and the army... can you imagine?"

873.speaker: Lucita Azaro
873.text: "Needless to say, my father is very much looking forward to serving at your side."
873.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_PromisedDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == false) == false

874.speaker: Player_Romus
874.text: "I'm relieved his recovery is proceeding on course. It'll be a pleasure to work with him again."

878.speaker: Player_Romus
878.text: "I'm relieved his recovery is proceeding on course. It'll be a pleasure to work with him."

882.speaker: Player_Romus
882.text: "I couldn't imagine retaking Pales without him."

883.speaker: Player_Romus
883.text: "And you're sure he's sharp enough to lead our armies?"

884.speaker: Lucita Azaro
884.text: "His body may be incapacitated, but his mind is certainly not."

886.speaker: Lucita Azaro
886.text: "But of course, you have the power to issue your own commands as you see fit."

887.speaker: Player_Romus
887.text: "I must say I've grown fond of having you on the Council. I'd prefer it if he doesn't replace you just yet."

888.speaker: Lucita Azaro
888.text: "It will still be a while, as you've seen. But even incapacitated, he's got one of the sharpest minds in the country."

889.speaker: Player_Romus
889.text: "The feeling is mutual. As long as he doesn't start any more wars."

891.speaker: Lucita Azaro
891.text: "Your father wanted to retake Pales as much as mine did. Possibly more so."

892.speaker: Lucita Azaro
892.text: "Treat our house well, and Father -- General Taddeus -- will be your fiercest protector, as he was King Valero's."

894.speaker: Lucita Azaro
894.text: "Of course, we'd need a strong military. And you'd have to get rid of the House of Delegates, but I always found them rather silly anyway..."

898.speaker: Lucita Azaro
898.text: "In any case, I'm looking forward to having Father back at full strength."

899.speaker: Lucita Azaro
899.text: "In any case, I'm looking forward to having Father back at full strength."

903.speaker: Lucita Azaro
903.text: "Do me a favor and forget that comment I made about Ana Azaro's plans, God rest her soul."
